title: 基于客户数字孪生模拟的大规模聊天机器人验证
summary: 提出通过真实交易和对话数据创建高保真合成客户代理（SCA）作为数字孪生的方法，结合LLM-as-a-Judge评估、专家测试和对抗性探测，实现大规模聊天机器人验证。在英国领先银行的应用表明，该方法在语义对齐、低幻觉率和可控干预方面表现优异，为受监管领域的合规部署提供了可扩展路径。
summary_en: Introduces a methodology for creating high-fidelity synthetic customer agents (SCAs) as digital twins grounded in real data, combined with LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation, expert testing, and adversarial probing for large-scale chatbot validation. Applied at a leading UK bank, it demonstrates strong semantic alignment, low hallucination, and controllable interventions, offering a scalable path to regulatory compliance.
